title: Resident Evil Degeneration
notes: Physical ARM64 test on 2026-10-06 with IPA SHA-256 987e29fd4ba6d64312907ae5c3c9526d160a419a5720d2501a1f15fbaa197a31. The intro reaches the main menu after about 75 seconds; part of the cutscene is cropped to a narrow strip at the bottom. New Game reaches Leon's first in-game tutorial scene with 3D world and HUD visible. A tap at the visible New Game button did not activate it, while a tap at a displaced position did; the input trace shows the screen touch being rotated into a portrait 320x480 GLView. Movement, shooting, audio quality and saving were not verified. Do not treat this as fully playable.
